violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 DR UPR refrigerator True; 2 prep cooler at service area.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please purchase thermometers and place them in warmest part of refrigeration units.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM WAS IN RESTAURANT UPON EHS ARRIVAL.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT HANDSINK ON COOKLINE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK. EL CATRIN (Inspection Date: 10/21/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO HAND SOAP AVAILABLE AT THE HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: HANDSOAP PROVIDED TO HANDWASHING SINK.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED A CAN OF RAID IN THE DRY STORAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RAID REMOVED FROM FACILITY DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED A SIGNIFICANT NUMBER OF SMALL FLIES IN THE BACK NEAR THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE GET PEST CONTROL ON OR BEFORE 10/31/25. INVOICE SHOULD INDICATE IT HAS BEEN TREATED FOR THE VARIOUS FLIES IN FACILITY.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: OBSERVED HEAVILY SOILED WIPING CLOTHS THROUGHOUT FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SEVERAL CEILING TILES MISSING IN BACK STORAGE AREA. OBSERVED SEVERAL TILES DAMAGED BY WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE REPLACE DAMAGED CEILING TILES WITH EASILY CLEANABLE TILES. INSTALL EASILY CLEANABLE CEILING TILES WHERE THEY ARE MISSING.

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. OBSERVED VARIOUS ITEMS NOT NECESSARY TO THE OPERATION OF THE FACILITY SUCH AS: OLD PAINTINGS, SIGNIFICANT AMOUNTS OF CLOTH/BLANKETS, BROKEN CHAIRS, AND HOOKAH
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. PLEASE SORT OUT WHAT IS UNNECESSARY AND REMOVE IT FROM THE PREMISES.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED CURLING IRON, HAIR BRUSHES, MEDICINES, AND VARIOUS OTHER PERSONAL ITEMS IN THE DRY STORAGE AND BEHIND THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. ALL PERSONAL ITEMS MUST BE SEPARATED AND PLACED IN A DESIGNATED AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the dish area is blocked by a large trash can, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Trash can moved.
